info.name: Chess Mission Mobile API
info.description: Chess Mission mobile authentication, application configuration, onboarding, player profile, location, and geography API contract. Includes password, four-digit email OTP, Google, and Apple login. Every request includes saved success and important error examples. Successful login and refresh requests automatically save access_token, refresh_token, and session_id as collection variables.

request.description: Public mobile feature configuration. Show native Apple Sign-In only when data.auth.apple.enabled is true, the device is iOS, and AppleAuthentication.isAvailableAsync() returns true. If this request fails, hide Apple Sign-In by default.

response.name: 200 - Apple Sign-In Enabled
200 - Apple Sign-In Disabled

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Authenticates an active Chess Mission account using email and password. Required fields: email, password, device_name, platform (android or ios), and a stable device_id. Returns a 15-minute access token and a rotating 30-day refresh token.

response.name: 200 - Authentication Successful

originalRequest.description: Authenticates an active Chess Mission account using email and password. Returns a 15-minute access token and a rotating 30-day refresh token.

request.description: Step 1 of Apple Login. Call this only when GET /api/v1/app-config returns data.auth.apple.enabled=true. Creates a cryptographically random, single-use nonce valid for 10 minutes. The test script saves data.nonce as {{apple_nonce}}. The mobile app must send SHA-256(apple_nonce) to Apple and later submit the original apple_nonce to the Apple Login endpoint.

request.description: Step 2 of Apple Login. First call Create Apple Nonce. Hash the returned raw nonce with lowercase SHA-256 hex and pass that digest to Apple's authorization request. Then send Apple's identity token plus the original raw nonce here. first_name and last_name are optional and should be sent only when Apple supplies them on first authorization. Existing Apple subjects can log in without email; new users require an Apple-verified email, including private-relay addresses.
